meta._note: PROACTIVE variant of catalog-service.guide.json (STRATA-GUIDE.md Part 2, 'Case B path 2' — untested until 2026-07-28). Identical to the default guide except for one addition: the `order` domain, specified BEFORE any task has ever built it. Everything else is a strict copy, so this file isolates ONE variable: does a hand-authored spec reduce FIRST-touch domain-invention cost, the thing retroactive capture structurally cannot touch.

guidance: Persistence is IN-MEMORY. @prisma/client is NOT installed and prisma/schema.prisma is aspirational — do NOT add Prisma, do NOT run migrations, do NOT reconcile against those tables. New entities (users, sessions, audit, idempotency, orders) use in-memory stores. Products are served from src/data/productRepository.js.

prisma._note: Declared only to record the truth: this schema exists but @prisma/client is not installed and nothing uses it at runtime. Bind nothing here.

domains.name: order
domains._note: PROACTIVE — nothing under this name exists in the codebase yet. Fields/rules/operations below are a spec to IMPLEMENT, not a description of code that already exists (contrast with product/user/audit above, which describe or anticipate real files). No storeInterface/methodAliases/enforcedAt/implementedIn are given for that reason — there is nothing real yet for those to point at.

fields.name: items
fields._note: Element shape, using the project's own vocabulary: prisma/schema.prisma names the field quantity, so a line item does too. Declaring it is what lets generated validation reject quantity:-5 — without it the list is checked for existence and waved through.

fields.name: totalCents
fields._note: Computed server-side at creation time from live Product prices — see rules and dependsOn below. Never accept a client-sent total.

rules.text: A retried request carrying the same Idempotency-Key must not create a second order — the original order is returned instead, unchanged.
Order creation validates the request body (userId present, at least one line item, each line item's sku resolving to a real Product) BEFORE anything is created.
totalCents is always computed server-side by summing live Product prices for the requested quantities — a client-sent total is never trusted, even if present in the request body.
Every creation attempt is logged, whether it succeeds, is rejected for validation, or is short-circuited as a duplicate.
A new order always starts in status 'pending'. Only a separate payment step may transition it to 'paid'; nothing transitions it back from 'paid' to 'pending'.
A 'cancelled' order cannot be paid afterward, and a 'paid' order cannot be cancelled — cancellation is only valid while status is 'pending'.

operations.name: createOrder
requires: at least one line item with a valid product sku
operations.guarantees: a retried request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the ORIGINAL order, never a duplicate; totalCents reflects live Product prices, not client input

operations.name: listOrders
operations.guarantees: returns only that user's own orders, most recent first

operations.name: cancelOrder
requires: order belongs to the requesting user
operations.guarantees: cancellation is idempotent (cancelling an already-cancelled order is a no-op, not an error); rejects with a clear error if status is not 'pending'

dependsOn.via: every line item's sku must resolve to a live Product at creation time; price is read from Product, never trusted from the client
